arms.name: sickle-sword
arms.title: sickle-sword
arms.reason: A sickle-shaped iron blade with wood handle wrapped in hide, brass and copper wire, a classic Ngbandi/Ngbaka-region throwing/sickle knife form used as a weapon, matching the claimed ethnicity and category.

sculpture.name: Sculpture
sculpture.title: Pair of Figures
sculpture.reason: A pair of carved wooden standing figures with metal leg/arm rings, beaded earrings, fiber waist wrappings, and metal inlay details—characteristic Central African ancestor/power figure sculpture, museum attributed to Ngbandi-style carving (though only "probably" attributed, this is independent stylistic evidence, not a bare country label).
